cosmetic-injection.name: Botulinum & Filler Unit Calculator
cosmetic-injection.intro: Work out reference dosing for botulinum toxin and hyaluronic acid filler from the treatment area and muscle strength.

rf-tightening.name: RF Skin Tightening Calculator
rf-tightening.intro: Estimate dermal collagen stimulation and skin lifting grade from radiofrequency temperature, dwell time and session frequency.

chemical-peel.name: Chemical Peel Depth Calculator
chemical-peel.intro: Estimate peel penetration depth and safety level from acid type, concentration, pH and contact time.

spf-pa-calculator.name: SPF / PA Requirement Calculator
spf-pa-calculator.intro: Recommend the SPF and PA level you need, and how long the protection lasts, from skin phototype, UV index and time outdoors.

thread-lift.name: Thread Lift Vector & Angle Calculator
thread-lift.intro: Compute the lift force vectors of barbed threads from treatment area, thread type and insertion angle, with an optimal entry-angle suggestion.

microneedle.name: Microneedle Penetration Calculator
microneedle.intro: Calculate penetration depth and active-ingredient delivery from needle length, spacing, density and number of passes.

ratio-composition-injection.name: Skin Booster Ratio Calculator
ratio-composition-injection.intro: Split a target total volume into each ingredient's volume from a given concentration ratio for skin booster injections.

calc-51.name: Sunscreen SPF / PA Calculator
calc-51.intro: Derive SPF and PA grades from a product's UVB and UVA blocking rates and compare protection across formulations.

formula-1.name: Mesotherapy Formula Calculator
formula-1.intro: Turn a target total volume and ingredient ratios into the exact volume of every ingredient for mesotherapy compounding.

injection.name: Cosmetic Injection Dose Calculator
injection.intro: Look up recommended botulinum toxin or hyaluronic acid units by product type, treatment area and desired effect.

length-spacing.name: Microneedle Density Calculator
length-spacing.intro: Derive needle density, coverage area and true penetration depth from microneedle length and spacing.

post-procedure-recovery.name: Post-Procedure Recovery Schedule
post-procedure-recovery.intro: Generate a day-by-day redness, swelling and scabbing recovery timeline with stage-by-stage aftercare and sun-protection guidance.

time-23.name: Aesthetic Recovery Timeline
time-23.intro: Pick an aesthetic procedure type to get a redness, swelling and scabbing recovery timeline with aftercare advice.

wrinkle-dynamic-static.name: Dynamic & Static Wrinkle Assessor
wrinkle-dynamic-static.intro: Score dynamic (expression) and static (at-rest) wrinkles by facial zone to guide botulinum and filler planning.

temp-time-4.name: RF Tightening Effect Assessor
temp-time-4.intro: Assess collagen contraction and skin tightening effect from the target dermal temperature and dwell time of radiofrequency treatment.

skin-ph.name: Skin pH Assessment
skin-ph.intro: Enter a skin pH reading to evaluate acid-base balance and barrier health against the normal 4.5-5.5 range.

meso-cocktail.name: Mesotherapy Cocktail Builder
meso-cocktail.intro: Select treatment goals by skin concern and get a mesotherapy cocktail formula with concentrations and injection parameters.

pore-grading.name: Pore Enlargement Grading
pore-grading.intro: Grade pore enlargement per facial zone from visible pore count and density under magnification, with improvement suggestions.

eyebag-assessment.name: Under-Eye Bag Assessor
eyebag-assessment.intro: Grade lower-lid fat herniation, tell eye bags apart from aegyo-sal and puffiness, and point to a treatment direction.

mesotherapy.name: Skin Booster Formula Builder
mesotherapy.intro: Calculate active-ingredient ratios, recommended concentrations and total injection volume for skin boosters by skin concern.

corneometer.name: Corneometer Hydration Assessment
corneometer.intro: Assess stratum corneum hydration and barrier function from Corneometer CM825 readings in arbitrary units.

concentration.name: Chemical Peel Depth Estimator
concentration.intro: Estimate chemical exfoliation depth and action layer from acid concentration and pH to support treatment design.

pifuphceding.name: Skin pH Meter
pifuphceding.intro: Enter a skin pH value to judge acid-base status and barrier health and to guide sensitive-skin care.

maokongcudafenji.name: Pore Size Grader
maokongcudafenji.intro: Enter pore diameter and facial zone to grade pore enlargement and receive improvement suggestions.

assessor-67.name: Cosmetic Filing Compliance Check
assessor-67.intro: Compare heavy-metal, methanol and microbiological test values against public limits to judge whether a cosmetic passes filing or registration.
assessor-67.zh: 注册（备案/检验/安全评估）流程

visia-spots.name: VISIA Spot Area & Depth Assessment
visia-spots.intro: Assess the area share and pigment depth of facial spots in the spirit of VISIA skin analysis and output a severity grade.

laser-parameters.name: Laser Parameters & Target Lookup
laser-parameters.intro: Look up wavelength, pulse width, chromophore target, penetration depth and indications for aesthetic lasers.

area-12.name: Telangiectasia Area Assessment
area-12.intro: Estimate capillary dilation from the facial zone and the share of area covered by erythema to help judge barrier problems.

fitzpatrick-wrinkle.name: Fitzpatrick Wrinkle & Elasticity Assessment
fitzpatrick-wrinkle.intro: Combine Fitzpatrick wrinkle grading with skin elasticity scoring to judge facial ageing and suggest treatment.

glogau-photoaging.name: Glogau Photoaging Classification
glogau-photoaging.intro: Classify the photoaging grade from wrinkle, pigmentation and keratosis indicators using the Glogau scale.

telangiectasia-area.name: Facial Telangiectasia Area Assessment
telangiectasia-area.intro: Assess the area share, vessel type and severity of facial capillary dilation and provide a treatment reference.

sebumeter.name: Sebumeter Sebum Output Assessment
sebumeter.intro: Assess sebum output per facial zone from Sebumeter readings in micrograms per square centimetre and identify the skin type.

jiguangbochangbadian.name: Laser Wavelength Target Lookup
jiguangbochangbadian.intro: Choose a laser type to see its target chromophore, penetration depth and clinical indications for device selection.
